thread:
maya: Quick sync — deploy tonight 02:00 UTC. Changes: API header rename, runtime kernel batch toggle, console prefetch. Need router pin for prefetch and console pin to rc.
tony: On it. I'll pin console to rc and drop a note in release notes about the header rename.
frida: Router can do a short-lived route for /prefetch-check -> canary. Will require X-Canary header. ETA 4m.
deploybot: Plan: canary 5% at 02:10 for 10m, gate on 5xx < 0.5% and p95 < 600ms. Auto-rollback if thresholds breached.
maya: Console will start prefetch after canary is green. Endpoint: POST /internal/prefetch?scope=canary with OP token.
frida: Rule applied. TTL 8m. Added header filter X-Canary=true.
deploybot: Canary started. 0/50 failing. Monitoring latency and errors.
deploybot: Canary update (02:15): p95 spike to 720ms, 3/50 failed checks, no 5xx. Placing HOLD.
maya: Likely kernel warmup. Let's enable console fallback and see effect. No rollback yet.
tony: Flipping console fallback flag now. UI will serve cached values when prefetch fails.
router-bot: Logs: increased latency on /generate, consistent with runtime warmup. No 5xx surge.
deploybot: After fallback and minor batch ramp, p95 dropped to 470ms. Can resume to 25% at 02:30.
maya: Resume approved. Keep kv.prefetch_miss and X-KV-Fallback metrics for 72h. Add short changelog note about warmup mitigation.
frida: Removed temporary route after prefetch window. Confirm no pins remain.
deploybot: Rollout to 25% started. Full rollout scheduled 03:00 if stable.
maya: If thresholds breach, open #incidents and tag eng-sre. Postmortem to include timeline and mitigation steps.
tony: I'll publish the private-deploy how-to for the prefetch endpoint and fallback header.
router-bot: Standing by for any routing rollbacks.
maya: Thanks all — stand down unless alerts fire.
